name: fz517_hyper_beam_sub
purpose: Hyper Beam into a Substitute (issue 517): Conkeldurr, p2b, breaks Ninetales' Substitute with Hyper Beam (step 1); the pin sets mustrecharge (the Substitute's target is null, not false, data/mods/champions/scripts.ts:349-352, so selfDrops runs, sim/battle-actions.ts:1317-1335) and the next request is the recharge (step 2). A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_2_72), cut after its step 2: adopted as a regression fixture. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
